limitations_admitted.value: The assumed CO production rate of 4e28 mol s^-1 used in the dust velocity calculation is somewhat arbitrary.

evidence.quote: The assumed CO production rate (1860 kg $^{-1}$) is reasonable but somewhat arbitrary.

referee_caveats_inferred: The relative radio emissivity (epsilon_r = 0.70 +- 0.13) is adopted from TNOs/Centaurs rather than directly measured at multiple wavelengths for C/2014 UN271, dominating the final diameter uncertainty.

The two scheduling blocks show a ~2-sigma difference in measured target flux density (0.109+-0.016 mJy in SB1 vs 0.147+-0.016 mJy in SB2), which is averaged together without detailed discussion of potential short-term rotational variability.

missing_for_reproduction: Exact tool and settings used for visibility fitting of the science target and calibrators
Mie + effective medium theory dust thermal model code
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Small (~5-20 GB): two 1-hour scheduling blocks in ALMA Band 6 TDM (continuum) mode with 40 antennas.
reproducibility.score_reason: The observational setup, calibration rescaling factors (0.99 and 0.995), per-SB flux measurements, uv-binning (400 m), and all NEATM parameters and priors are explicitly stated in the text and tables. Minor deductions for not naming the specific visibility-fitting software or releasing the custom NEATM/Mie modeling scripts.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA dataset (2019.A.00038.T) in simple TDM continuum mode with clearly documented calibration rescaling and analytic/NEATM equations leading directly to the main numeric results (flux, diameter, albedo).
